answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, at epoch start, evaluate a committed polynomial whose identity-bound shares are registered in a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree. RLN permits one valid message per epoch; a duplicate nonce yields two points, enabling Shamir interpolation to recover the signer’s private key and trigger instantaneous collateral slashing. Thus, a sybil cannot safely multiply identities, whether its sonnet, echo, or inlet carries the replay.
